summary: Atlas Critical Minerals Corporation filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, reporting that it engaged SGS Canada Inc. to prepare an S-K 1300 Technical Report Summary, including a maiden mineral resource estimate, for its Malacacheta Graphite Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The TRS is dated September 23, 2026, with an effective date of September 14, 2026, and is filed as Exhibit 96.1, with the qualified person consent filed as Exhibit 23.1. No transaction, shareholder vote, price, premium, or board recommendation is stated; this is a routine technical disclosure, not a special situation.
